data.title: Bitcoin Jumps to $71,500 on Trump’s ‘Sizeable’ Buy Plan. Why MSTR Is Still the Wrong Bet
data.description: Trump just signaled the U.S. government could buy Bitcoin at a "sizeable" scale, sending prices past $71,500 and Strategy shares soaring nearly 10%. But a closer look at Strategy's latest moves raises a question every crypto investor should ask before piling in.
data.keywords: Trump, Bitcoin ETF, digital assets, preferred dividends, Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
